note: Each row is a claim M9 makes and the mechanical check that can refute it. A claim with no refuting check does not belong here — it belongs in the report as an observation.

assertions.claim: A3 reports an unimportable tiktoken instead of killing the process
assertions.refutes_by: asserting stdout still parses; a crashed run leaves stdout empty, which exit code alone cannot distinguish from a non-computed status

assertions.claim: an absent interpreter and an absent tokenizer are different statuses
assertions.check: measureA3 sets status='error' with a tiktoken reason on ImportError, 'baseline-unavailable' otherwise
assertions.refutes_by: live run reports status=error, not_delivered_reason contains 'tiktoken'
assertions.observed: status=error, reason='tiktoken unavailable: ... No module named tiktoken'

assertions.claim: backlogged panel findings are closed as deferred and the closure rate does not move
assertions.refutes_by: asserting counts.resolved stays 0 while counts.deferred rises, and total does not grow
assertions.observed: live shard open 66 -> 59, numerator 0 unchanged, denominator 66 unchanged

assertions.claim: a blocking entry the panel never opened is skipped, not fabricated
assertions.refutes_by: asserting the synthesised verdict=fail rows produce no closed record with opened_at null

assertions.claim: a failed backlog append closes nothing
assertions.check: negative test with a header-less backlog
assertions.refutes_by: asserting the finding is still open after a non-zero exit

assertions.claim: deferring a finding never counts as resolving it
assertions.check: countFindings separates RESOLVING_CLOSURE_TYPES from the rest
assertions.refutes_by: a fixture with all closure types asserts resolved counts only fixed + invalidated
assertions.observed: pass; live C1 0/66 -> 5/66 with 7 deferred excluded from the numerator

assertions.claim: attribution enumerates only resolved findings that carry a join key
assertions.check: findings-unattributed against a fixture with fixed / invalidated / deferred rows
assertions.refutes_by: asserting the deferred row is absent and every returned row has gate_decision_id

assertions.claim: a resolved finding with no gate_decision_id is dropped rather than guessed at
assertions.check: fixture with a fixed finding and no stamp
assertions.observed: pass; the live M7 cohort reports 0 for exactly this reason

assertions.claim: A2 cannot be produced in this installation, and the reason is the denominator rather than the numerator
assertions.refutes_by: applying the repo's only context-window constant to 5 live transcripts yields negative remaining (-21% to -195%)

assertions.claim: a row flipped to canonical complete with a false predicate fails the gate
assertions.refutes_by: fixture PRD with a bare `complete` cell and no metrics corpus must exit non-zero

assertions.claim: a row still carrying its marker is not checked and does not fail
assertions.check: same gate against a non-canonical fixture

assertions.claim: M8 may not be flipped until the A2 revision is reflected in the PRD, not merely written
assertions.check: predicate checks both file existence and PRD reference
assertions.refutes_by: before the revision the predicate was measured false with a2Doc=true a2Revised=false
assertions.observed: false before the revision, true after

assertions.claim: the PRD is archivable after normalisation
assertions.refutes_by: counts must show inProgress 0 and nonCanonical 0 across all 9 rows

assertions.claim: the archive move plan resolves to the PRD plus all 9 plans with no C2 violation
assertions.check: archive-complete/apply.js preflight with the full planPaths set
assertions.refutes_by: errors[] must be empty and the move list must contain 10 entries
assertions.observed: errors [], 10 moves. The destructive run is DEFERRED to after this cycle's PR - executing it now moves the m9 plan and self-blocks the PR staleness guard (CLAUDE.md 3.11 guard 2)
